source_text: 1. Quon1am igitur in hoe mundo quidam quidem accurrunt lumini, et per fidem uniunt se Deo; alii autem absistunt a lumine, et separant seipsos a Deo: venit Verbum Dei, omnibus aptam habitationem inferens ; his quidem qui in lumine sunt, ut fruantur eo, et his quee in eo sunt bonis: his autem qui in tenebris sunt, ut participentur eas calamitates quze in eis sunt. Et propter hoe ait, hos quidem qui sunt ad dexteram vocari in regnum Patris: autem qui sunt a sinistra in eternum ignem missurum, Semetipsos enim omnibus privaverunt bonis, 2. Et propter hoe Apostolus ait: Pro eo quod dilectionem Dei non receperunt, ut salvi ferent, et ideo mittet eis Deus operationem erroris, ut credant mendacio, ut judicentur omnes qui non crediderunt veritati, sed consenserunt iniquitati : illo enim veniente, et sua sententia apostasiam recapitulante in semetipsum, et sua voluntate et arbitrio operante quaecunque operabitur, et in templo Dei sedente, ut sicut Christum adorent illum qui seducentur ab quapropter et juste in stagnum projicietur ignis ; Deo autem secundum suam providentiam preesciente omnia, et apto tempore eum qui talis futurus erat immittente, wt credant falso, ut judicentur omnes qui non crediderunt veritati, sed consenserunt iniquitati. Cujus adventum Johannes in Apocalypsi significavit ita: Et bestia quam videram, similis erat pardo, et pedes ejus quasi ursi, et os ejus quasi os leonis; et dedit ei draco virtutem suam, et thronum suum, et potestatem magnam; et unum ew capitibus ejus’ quasi occisum in mortem, e plaga mortis ejus curata est, et admirata est universa terra post bestiam: et adoraverunt draconem, 4 quoniam dedit potestatem bestie ; et adoraverunt bestiam dicentes: Quis similis bestice illi, et quis potest pugnare cum ipsa? Et datum est e os loquens magna et blasphemiam, et data est ei potestas mensibus xu. et ®duobus. Et aperuit os swum ad blasphemium adversus Deum, blasphemare nomen ejus, et tabernaculum ejus, et eos qui in colo habitant, Ht data est ei potestas super omnem tribum, et populum, et linguam, et gentem. Et adoraverunt eum omnes qui habitant super terram, cujus non est scriptum nomen in libro vitee Agni occisi a constitutione mundi. Si quis habet aures, audiat. Si quis in captivitatem duxerit, in captivitatem ibit. Si quis gladio occioportet eum in gladio occidi. Hic est sustinentia et fides sanctorum. Post deinde et de armigero ejus, quem et pseudoprophetam vocat : Loguebatur, inquit, quasi draco, et potestatem prime bestice omnem faciebat in conspectu aus : et facit terram, et qui habitant in ea, ut adorarent bestiam primam, cujus curata est plaga mortis ejus. Et faciet signa magna, ut e ignem faciat de celo descendere in terram in conspectu hominum ; et seducet inhabitantes super terram, Heee ne quis eum divina virtute putet signa facere, sed magica operatione. Et non est mirandum, si deemoniis et apostaticis spiritibus ministrantibus ei, per eos faciat signa, in seducat habitantes super terram. Et imaginem, ait, Jubebit fiers bestiae, et spiritum dabit imagini, uti et loquatur imago, et eos qui non adoraverint eam faciet occidi. Et characterem autem, ait, in fronte, et in manu dextra faciet dari, ne possit aliquis emere vel vendere, nisi qui habet characterem nominis bestia, vel numerum nominis ejus: et esse numerum sexcentos sexaginta sew, quod est, sexies centeni, et deni sewies, et singulares sex; im universze apostasize ejus, quze facta est in sex millibus annorum. 8. Quotquot enim diebus hic factus est mundus, tot et millenis annis consummatur. Et propter hoe ait Scriptura Et consummata sunt celum et terra, et omnis ornatus ecorum. consummavit Deus die sexto omnia opera sua que fecit, et requievit in die septimo ab omnibus operibus suis que fecit. Hoe autem est et antefactorum narratio, quemadmodum facta sunt, et futurorum prophetia. Etenim dies Domini quasi mille anni; in sex autem diebus consummata sunt que facta sunt: manifestum est quoniam consummatio ipsorum sextus millesimus annus est. Et propter hoc in omni tempore, plasmatus initio homo per manus Dei, id est, Filii et Spiritus, fit secundum imaginem et similitudinem Dei, paleis quidem abjectis, quee sunt apostasia ; frumento autem in horreum assumto, quod est hi qui ad Deum fide fructificant. Et propterea tribulatio necessaria est his qui salvantur, ut quodammodo contriti, et attenuati, et conspersi per patientiam Verbo Dei, et igniti, apti sint ad convivium Regis. Quemadmodum quidam de nostris dixit, propter martyrium in Deum adjudicatus ad bestias: Quoniam frumentum sum Christi, et per dentes bestiarum molor, ut mundus panis Dei inveniar. Universa ad utilitatem hominum facta esse: et de Antichristi dolis, nequitia, vi apostatica a diluvio, et deinceps in Ananie, Azarie et Misaelis persecutione, prafigurata.
thought_title: Division of Humanity and the Coming of the Word
pass_a_gloss: Therefore in this world indeed some rush to the light and through faith unite themselves to God; but others stand away from the light and separate themselves from God: the Word of God comes, bringing a suitable dwelling for all; for those indeed who are in the light, so that they may enjoy it and the good things that are in it; but for those who are in darkness, so that they may participate in the calamities that are in them. And because of this, He says, those on the right will be called into the kingdom of the Father; but those on the left will be sent into eternal fire. For they have deprived themselves of all good things. And because of this, the Apostle says: Because they did not receive the love of God, so that they might be saved, and therefore God will send them a working of error, so that they may believe a lie, so that all who did not believe the truth but consented to iniquity may be judged. For when he comes, and with his own judgment recapitulates the apostasy into himself, and with his own will and decision operates whatever he will operate, and sitting in the temple of God, so that those who are seduced may adore him as Christ; therefore, he will be justly thrown into the lake of fire. But God, according to His own providence, foreknowing all things, and at the suitable time sending him who was to be such, so that they may believe a lie, so that all who did not believe the truth but consented to iniquity may be judged. The coming of whom John signified in the Apocalypse thus: And the beast that I saw was like a leopard, and its feet were like those of a bear, and its mouth was like the mouth of a lion; and the dragon gave it his power and his throne and great authority; and one of its heads was as if slain to death, and the wound of its death was healed, and the whole earth was amazed after the beast; and they worshiped the dragon, because he gave authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying: Who is like the beast, and who can fight with it? And there was given to it a mouth speaking great things and blasphemy, and there was given to it authority for forty-two months. And it opened its mouth to blasphemy against God, to blaspheme His name and His tabernacle and those who dwell in heaven. And there was given to it authority over every tribe and people and language and nation. And all who dwell on the earth worshiped it, whose name has not been written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world. If anyone has ears, let him hear. If anyone is to be taken captive, to captivity he will go. If anyone is to be slain with the sword, with the sword he will be slain. This is the patience and faith of the saints. After this, also about his armor-bearer, whom he also calls a false prophet: He spoke, he says, like a dragon, and he performed all the power of the first beast in the sight of men; and he makes the earth and those who dwell in it worship the first beast, whose wound of death was healed. And he will perform great signs, so that he even makes fire come down from heaven to earth in the sight of men; and he will seduce the inhabitants of the earth, so that they do not think he performs signs by divine power, but by magical operation. And it is not wonderful, if he, with demons and apostate spirits ministering to him, performs signs through them, and seduces the inhabitants of the earth. And an image, he says, he will make of the beast, and he will give breath to the image, so that the image even speaks, and he will make those who do not worship it be killed. And a mark, he says, will be given on the forehead and on the right hand, so that no one can buy or sell, except he who has the mark of the name of the beast or the number of his name: and the number is six hundred sixty-six, which is, six times one hundred, and ten times six, and six singles; in all the apostasy that was made in six thousand years. For as many days as the world was made, so many thousand years it will be completed. And because of this, Scripture says: And the heaven and the earth and all their adornment were completed. God completed all His works that He made on the sixth day, and He rested on the seventh day from all His works that He made. But this is also a narrative of past things, how they were made, and a prophecy of future things. For the day of the Lord is like a thousand years; but in six days the things that were made were completed: it is clear that the completion of them is the sixth thousandth year. And because of this, in all time, man, formed at the beginning by the hands of God, that is, of the Son and the Spirit, is made according to the image and likeness of God, casting away indeed the chaff, which are apostasies; but gathering the wheat into the storehouse, which are those who bear fruit to God through faith. And therefore, tribulation is necessary for those who are saved, so that, being somehow broken and attenuated and sprinkled through patience with the Word of God, and being ignited, they may be fit for the banquet of the King. As one of ours said, having been condemned to the beasts for martyrdom in God: For I am the wheat of Christ, and I am ground by the teeth of the beasts, so that I may be found as pure bread of God. All things were made for the utility of men: and about the cunning of the Antichrist, and his wickedness, and his apostate power from the flood, and from then on in the persecution of Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, prefigured.

For they have deprived themselves of every good thing.
